CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
May 26, 2026 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Deacon Paul Machuca, Beatitudes of Our Lord Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: VFW Post 9148
4.

Councilmember Bean
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR MILITARY APPRECIATION MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2026 as Military Appreciation Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to VFW Post 9148 Commander Kurt Urban.
5.1 Proclamation for Military Appreciation
6.
APPOINTMENTS
6.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION – It is recommended the City Council appoint Michelle Lynch to the Public Safety and Traffic Commission for a term ending in June 2028.
6.1 Appointment - Michelle Lynch
7.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of May 12, 2026, the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of May 12, 2026.
8.1 Study Session Minutes
8.1 City Council Minutes
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated May 26, 2026 in the total amount of $2,660,842.69.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING APRIL 2026 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending April 2026.
8.3 Investment Report April
8.4
WAREHOUSE NON-EXCLUSIVE LICENSE FOR PHANTOM PROJECTS – It is recommended the City Council approve the non-exclusive license for Fiscal Year 2026-27 for Phantom Projects in the amount of $130,520 and authorize the City Manager to execute the license on behalf of the City.
8.4 Phantom Projects
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2025-01, SLURRY SEAL OF VALLEY VIEW AVENUE FROM ROSECRANS AVENUE TO 330 FEET SOUTH OF ALONDRA BOULEVARD AND NORTHBOUND LANES FROM PARK PLACE TO ARTESIA BOULEVARD – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK – It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Pavement Coatings Co., authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
8.5 CIP No. 2025-01 Slurry Seal of Valley View
8.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2025-06, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 7 – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT – It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2025-06, Neighborhood Slurry Seal Area 7, to American Asphalt South, Inc. in the amount of $484,426.20, authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City, authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction inspection and testing services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost, and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total construction cost.
8.6 CIP No. 2025-06 Slurry Seal Area 7
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 26-14 APPROVAL OF TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP (TPM) NO. 85016 TO CONSOLIDATE TWO PARCELS INTO ONE AT 14602 SAN ARDO DRIVE, WITHIN THE SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONING DISTRICT (R-1-6000) AND FINDING THE PROJECT EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) GUIDELINES PURSUANT TO SECTION 15315, CLASS 15 (“MINOR LAND DIVISIONS”) OF THE CEQA GUIDELINES – It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; affirm the CEQA Categorical Exemption; and adopt Resolution No. 26-14 approving Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) No. 85016 to consolidate two parcels into one at 14602 San Ardo Drive, within the Single-Family Residential District (R-1-6000).
9.1 Reso. No. 26-14 TPM for San Ardo
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 26-15 ADOPTING A POLICY ADDRESSING THE DISRUPTION OF INTERNET OR TELEPHONIC SERVICES DURING PUBLIC MEETINGS – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 26-15 adopting a policy addressing the disruption of internet or telephonic services during public meetings.
10.1 Reso. No. 26-15 Disruption Policy
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 26-16 AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 25-11 REGARDING EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AND SALARY RATES - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 26-16 amending Resolution No. 25-11 regarding employment benefits and salary rates for all classes of employment in the City.
10.2 Reso. No. 26-16 Amending Reso. No. 25-11 Employment Rates
CITY COUNCIL
